page.content:
Image macros, copypasta, and viral forms tracked as vernacular folklore.

How Meme history connects

  • Topic: Image macro — The image macro is the basic still-plus-caption form of 2000s meme history.
  • Work: Know Your Meme — Know Your Meme became the reference desk of internet meme history.
  • Topic: Copypasta — Copypasta is the pasted-text tradition of meme folklore.
  • Topic: Godwin's law — Godwin's law is an early named law of online argument-as-meme.
  • Topic: Viral video — Viral video is the moving-image half of meme circulation.
  • Work: The Selfish Gene — Dawkins's meme chapter later labeled the folklore this subject tracks.
  • Work: All your base — All your base circulated as an early web meme before the lolcat boom.

What is Meme history?

Meme history treats catchphrases, image macros, and copypasta as dated folklore: Dawkins's coinage, Godwin's law, lolcats, rickrolls, Advice Animals, and the wikis that cataloged them. Entries here describe circulation, not endorsement.

Key threads lead to Image macro, Know Your Meme, Copypasta, Godwin's law, Viral video and The Selfish Gene.
